brief: Build a complete, self-contained landing page that serves as a showcase of GSAP animation techniques. Use the same color theme.

inputs.use: Exact requirements and all 25 technique categories.
Existing blue, slate, paper and navy theme tokens, including dark mode.
Mount the showcase in the existing GSAP page.

technology: GSAP, CSS perspective, inline SVG and Canvas 2D. No external image assets or Three.js needed.
assumptions: Ten cohesive screens cover every requested category; pinning adds scroll distance without adding sections.
Page transitions are demonstrated as an accessible miniature site inside the UI screen.
A Canvas 2D constellation represents the Canvas/WebGL category.
Desktop pinning becomes flowing content on mobile or short viewports.
Reduced motion and user pause present static scenes while preserving direct UI interaction.

updates.brief: For atlas-route svg, move circle along with the scroll. But, it should start only when parent section at the center of the viewport
updates.interpretation: Parent section center aligns with viewport center; complete at bottom center; linear reversible scrub.

updates.brief: Also, add a section with 3D cibe. User should be able to rotate it with a mousemove
updates.interpretation: A cube subsection in the depth screen preserves the ten-screen limit; CSS 3D rotation follows mouse position with touch and keyboard alternatives.

updates.brief: atlas-image-frame should stay at the center of the screen while it's scaling.
updates.interpretation: Pin the image frame from center center for its complete scroll-linked zoom/reveal interval, including reverse scrolling; no pin in reduced motion.
